statement: Be fruitful and multiply (procreate)
note: Genesis creation commission C0001 (no Mosaic type); restatements Gen 9:1, 9:7 sit only in passage groups.

statement: Circumcise sons (males) on the eighth day
note: Genesis record C0036 (record type Law, no Mosaic type); the Lev 12:3 eighth-day restatement is held only by passage group torah-leviticus-12-1.

statement: Do not eat the sciatic nerve (gid hanasheh)
note: Only the Genesis 32 passage group, which treats the sinew as a narrated custom (Study Context); no itemized record.

statement: Court sanctifies new months and fixes the calendar
note: C0091 fixes the Exodus month as first of the year; monthly sanctification and intercalation by the court are not stated.

statement: Slaughter the Passover offering at its appointed time
note: C0094 (Instruction; with Num 9:2-5, Deut 16:2, 6) itemizes the slaughter; Torah Law AUD-04-9-13 forbids failing to present it at its time.

statement: Eat the Passover meat roasted on the night of 15 Nisan
note: Only C0096, a meal procedure typed Instruction; the companion bans C0097-C0099 on eating it are Torah Law.

statement: Eat the second Passover offering with matzah and bitter herbs
note: Batch cites Ex 12:8; Maimonides' source is Num 9:11, held by C0841 (keep the second-month Passover).

statement: Do not eat the Passover offering raw or boiled
note: Two Torah Law records, one per clause of Ex 12:9.

statement: Do not leave Passover meat until morning
note: C0099 also holds Ex 34:25, Num 9:12 and Deut 16:4.

statement: Remove (destroy) all leaven by 14 Nisan
note: C0105 is typed Instruction while the paired bans C0109 (no leaven in houses) and AUD-02-13-7 are Torah Law.

statement: Rest on the first day of Passover
note: C0107 holds the 'holy day' clause (read as assembly); C0108 states the rest as a work ban; both cite Num 28 parallels.

statement: Rest on the seventh day of Passover
note: Same records as P159; each covers both the first and seventh days.

statement: Do not work on the first day of Passover
note: C0108 covers the first and seventh days, with Num 28:18, 25 and Deut 16:8.

statement: Do not work on the seventh day of Passover
note: Same record as N323; one record covers both festival days.

statement: Eat matzah on the first night of Passover
note: No record holds Ex 12:18; C0104 states eating unleavened bread all seven days, not the first-night duty specifically.

statement: Leaven must not be found in one's houses during Passover
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Do not eat any mixture containing leaven on Passover
note: No record holds Ex 12:20; C0106 (Ex 12:15, Deut 16:3) bans eating leaven without distinguishing mixtures.

statement: An apostate Israelite may not eat the Passover
note: C0111 excludes the 'foreigner' of 12:43; Maimonides reads that term as an apostate Israelite.

statement: A resident alien or hired worker may not eat the Passover
note: C0111 (12:43-45) covers them as 'otherwise ineligible persons'; its public context_note still carries an internal 'Rambam N126' edit note.

statement: Do not break a bone of the Passover offering
note: C0101 holds Ex 12:46 as additional Scripture.

statement: Do not take Passover meat out of the eating place
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: An uncircumcised man may not eat the Passover
note: C0111 names the uncircumcised exclusion (via 12:44), but its range 12:43-45 does not hold 12:48.

statement: Set apart the firstborn of clean animals as holy
note: C0115 is Command, C0212 Instruction; Deut 15:19's sanctify clause is unitemized, while firstborn rules C0119, C0877, C1045 are Torah Law.

statement: Do not eat leaven on Passover
note: Ex 13:3 holds only C0116 (remember the day); parallel C0106 (Ex 12:15, Deut 16:3) states the ban.

statement: Leaven must not be seen in one's domain on Passover
note: Direct Torah Law record, with Deut 16:4.

statement: Tell the Exodus story on the first night of Passover
note: C0088 holds Ex 13:8 as additional Scripture; teaching duties are consistently Instruction (C0978, C0990).

statement: Break the neck of an unredeemed firstborn donkey
note: Saints (LXX) Ex 13:13 and 34:20 say 'redeem it'/'give its value', with no neck-breaking; C0118 states the redemption.

statement: Do not go beyond the Sabbath boundary (techum)
note: Historical direction C0130 ties staying in place to manna gathering; Maimonides reads a standing Sabbath-limit rule.

statement: Know (believe) that God exists
note: Ex 20:2 has only studies (S019, passage group); C0985 (Deut 4:39) states acknowledging the Lord as God.

statement: Do not believe in or acknowledge any other god
note: C0146 (Ex 20:3) is Command; the parallel C0995 'Do not follow other gods' (Deut 6:14) is Torah Law.

statement: Do not make an idol for oneself (for worship)
note: C0147 is Command (also holds Ex 34:17, Deut 27:15); Lev 19:4, 26:1 idol-making clauses unitemized, while Lev 26:1 pillar/stone bans are Torah Law.

statement: Do not bow down to an idol
note: Decalogue ban typed Command; the Ex 23:24 bowing clause sits in C0241 (imitation, Law); penalty AUD-05-17-5 is Torah Law.

statement: Do not worship idols in their customary manner
note: Typed Command (with Deut 5:9, 7:16); the penalty for serving other gods, AUD-05-17-5, is Torah Law.

statement: Do not swear a vain (needless) oath by God's name
note: C0150 is typed Command; the companion false-oath ban of Lev 19:12 (C0604) is Torah Law.

statement: Sanctify the Sabbath verbally (Kiddush and Havdalah)
note: No record itemizes Ex 20:8 itself; C0129 holds the Deut 5:12 parallel but states Sabbath rest, not verbal sanctification.

statement: Do not do work on the Sabbath
note: The direct Decalogue ban C0152 is Command; Torah Law C0129 (holy Sabbath rest, with Deut 5:12) states the same rest; C0354 gives the penalty.

statement: Honour father and mother
note: C0153 is typed Command; the companion 'Revere father and mother' (Lev 19:3, C0595) is Torah Law.

statement: Do not kidnap a person
note: Maimonides reads Ex 20:14 'do not steal' (C0155, Command) as kidnapping; C0176 (Saints 21:17, Deut 24:7) is Torah Law.

statement: Do not murder
note: Decalogue ban typed Command; the murder penalty rules (AUD-04-35-16, C1083, C0950) are Torah Law.

statement: Do not testify falsely
note: Typed Command; related witness laws C0216 (Ex 23:1) and C1089 (Deut 19:19) are Torah Law.

statement: Do not covet (scheme to acquire) another's property
note: Both records typed Command; the similar 'Do not covet the silver or gold on idols' (C0999) is Torah Law.

statement: Do not make human figures, even for decoration
note: C0147 holds Ex 20:22-23 but states idols for worship; the decorative-image ban is not addressed. Its context_note holds a leftover edit instruction.

statement: Do not build the altar of hewn stones
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Do not ascend the altar by steps
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Deal with a Hebrew servant by his prescribed laws
note: C0164 (release after six years) also holds Deut 15:12.

statement: Master must designate (betroth) the Hebrew maidservant
note: C0166 states her redemption and C0168 her rights as the son's bride; the designation duty itself is not stated.

statement: Redeem the Hebrew maidservant
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Do not sell the Hebrew maidservant to another
note: C0167 follows the Saints wording 'to foreigners'.

statement: Do not withhold a wife's food, clothing or conjugal rights
note: Three Torah Law records, one per right.

statement: Do not strike father or mother
note: Scripture states it only as a capital penalty; C0174 itemizes it in that form.

statement: Court executes by strangulation those so sentenced
note: C0176 states the kidnapper's death penalty (Saints 21:17); the strangulation mode is not in the text.

statement: Do not curse father or mother
note: Batch shows Saints 21:17 (kidnapping); the cursing law is Saints 21:16, itemized by C0175 with Lev 20:9.

statement: Judge injury cases: the assailant pays damages
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Court executes by the sword those so sentenced
note: C0178 states the judgment on a master who kills a slave; the sword mode is not stated.

statement: Judge damages done by a goring ox
note: Four Torah Law records cover the goring-ox cases.

statement: Do not eat the flesh of an ox condemned to stoning
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Judge damages caused by an open pit
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Judge the thief: restitution, multiples or sale
note: Four Torah Law records cover restitution, the burglar, sale and double payment.

statement: Judge damage done by grazing animals
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Judge damage caused by fire
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Apply the laws of the unpaid custodian
note: AUD-02-22-6 (Law) with the oath and tribunal records C0194, C0193 typed Instruction.

statement: Judge claims between plaintiff and defendant
note: C0193 (Instruction) brings disputes before God's tribunal; C0195 (Law) sets double restitution; admission and oath rules are not separated.

statement: Apply the laws of the paid custodian and renter
note: Two Torah Law records; C0196's context_note holds a leftover edit instruction.

statement: Apply the laws of the borrower
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Seducer of an unbetrothed virgin pays the fine
note: Batch range 22:15-23 is too wide; the law is 22:15-16.

statement: Do not let a sorcerer live
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Do not wrong a convert with words
note: C0203 (with Lev 19:33) covers both clauses; the Saints text has 'resident foreigner' where Maimonides reads convert.

statement: Do not cheat a convert in business
note: Same record as N252 ('mistreat or oppress'); Maimonides assigns the second clause to monetary wrong.

statement: Do not afflict a widow or orphan
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Lend money to the poor
note: Ex 22:24 records state only pressing and interest; C1039 (Deut 15:8) is Instruction beside Torah Law C1037, C1038, C1040.

statement: Do not press a poor debtor known unable to pay
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Do not join an interest loan as guarantor, witness or scribe
note: C0206 states the lender's interest ban (with Lev 25:36-37, Deut 23:20); participation by others is not stated.

statement: Do not curse a judge
note: C0208 keeps 'gods', its referent under translation review; Maimonides reads elohim here as judges.

statement: Do not curse a ruler (head of state)
note: Direct Torah Law record (with Acts 23:4-5).

statement: Redeem the firstborn son
note: C0119 (Ex 13:13, 34:20); Ex 22:28's firstborn clause is not itemized, C0210 holding that verse only for the firstfruits clause.

statement: Do not separate tithes and terumah out of order
note: C0210 states 'do not delay' the firstfruits; Maimonides reads the delay as changing the order of the gifts.

statement: Do not eat flesh of a torn (treifah) animal
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Judge must not hear one litigant without the other
note: C0216 bans accepting or circulating false reports (which Maimonides includes); the judge's one-sided hearing rule is not stated.

statement: Do not accept testimony from a wicked person
note: No record itemizes Ex 23:1b (unrighteous witness); C0216 states only the false-report clause.

statement: Decide by majority vote in judicial disputes
note: Saints (LXX) Ex 23:2 lacks 'incline after the majority'; C0217 and C0218 state only the negative clauses.

statement: Do not convict in capital cases by a majority of one
note: C0217 bans following the crowd into wrongdoing; the capital-case majority rule is not stated.

statement: Judge who argued acquittal must not then argue conviction
note: C0218 states 'do not pervert justice'; the capital-case argument rule is not stated.

statement: Help unload an animal fallen under its burden
note: Direct Torah Law record; the Deut 22:4 restatement sits only in topical study S143.

statement: Do not leave an animal fallen under its load unaided
note: Direct Torah Law record.

statement: Judge must not pervert judgment against a habitual sinner
note: AUD-02-23-6 states the poor man's case; Maimonides reads 'poor' as poor in good deeds.

statement: Do not convict or execute on circumstantial evidence
note: C0224 'Do not execute the innocent or righteous'; Maimonides applies it to conviction without full testimony.

statement: Judge must not accept a bribe
note: Direct Torah Law record; the Deut 16:19 restatement sits only in study S135 and the passage group.

statement: Do not leave the festival offering's fat overnight
note: Batch cites Ex 23:10, apparently for 23:18; C0236 (Ex 23:18) itemizes it.

statement: Release all seventh-year produce as ownerless
note: Two Torah Law records.

statement: Rest on the Sabbath
note: C0152 (Command) holds Ex 23:12; Torah Law C0129 and AUD-02-31-13 state Sabbath rest.

statement: Do not swear by an idol
note: C0229 'Do not invoke the names of other gods' covers the clause.

statement: Do not lead others (the masses) to idolatry
note: C0229 covers invoking other gods' names; inciting others appears only as penalty law (C1025, Deut 13:10-12).

statement: Bring the festival offering at the three pilgrim feasts
note: C0230 states keeping the three feasts; Maimonides reads 'keep a feast' as the festival peace offering.

statement: Do not appear at a pilgrim feast without an offering
note: C0232 also holds Ex 34:20.

statement: Bring the firstfruits to the sanctuary
note: C0237 (Law, with Ex 34:26) and AUD-05-26-1 (Deut 26:1-2, Instruction).

statement: Do not cook meat with milk
note: The Ex 34:26 and Deut 14:21 restatements are not linked to C0238.

statement: Serve God through daily prayer
note: C0243 'Serve the Lord your God' is a covenant charge; Deut 11:13 and 13:5 sit only in passage groups and studies.

statement: Do not make a covenant with the seven nations
note: C0244 (with Ex 34:12, 15) is a historical direction; the seven-nations judgment AUD-05-20-17 is typed Torah Law.

statement: Do not let idolaters dwell in the land
note: Historical direction framed as a removal judgment; the comparable AUD-05-20-17 (Deut 20:17-18) is typed Torah Law.

statement: Build a sanctuary for God
note: C0252 is a one-time commission to make the tabernacle; no standing sanctuary-building record.

statement: Do not remove the carrying poles from the ark
note: C0255 'carry the ark by the poles retained in its rings' is a sanctuary specification; Maimonides counts a standing ban.

statement: Arrange the showbread and frankincense before God weekly
note: Priestly procedure records, all Instruction (C0264 holds Lev 24:8).

statement: Kindle the sanctuary lamps daily
note: C0284 holds Lev 24:3-4; C0831 (Num 8:2) arranges the lamps; the oil supply C0283 is Command.
